entries.reason: 1 s tick of the clock the bar always shows; no process.
Reads NIRI_SOCKET to decide whether the pinned upstream runtime applies; it calls nothing.
Developer motion meter started only through the iris `motion` IPC call; it reads the refresh rate with `niri msg -j outputs` and keeps the default 60 Hz when that fails.
Run only from IrisCompositorBlur.reload(), which is gated on CompositorService.compositorBlur (false in this port).
iNiR's display-sleep queue speaks `niri msg`; it runs only when the user puts displays to sleep, and outside niri the command exits with an error and the outputs stay on (kept as upstream).
60 s uptime refresh from upstream iNiR; reads /proc/uptime, no process.
60 s tick (_clockTick) that recomputes the time-dependent weather bindings; no process.
1 s world-clock tick; runs only while the World Clock desktop widget is enabled.
500 ms playback-position read from the in-process mpv player; runs only while a YouTube Music track is loaded.
1 s clock in the hub's Clock section; the hub exists only while it is open (Loader active: root.hubOpen).
1 s tick of the island clock the bar always shows; no process.
Agent usage refresh every refreshIntervalSec (default 900 s, at least 30 s; 180 s near a limit).
Update check every 6 hours.
50 ms countdown of a notification card's lifetime; exists per shown card and runs only while that card is counting down and not hovered (ticking).
15 s re-resolve of the default sink for the audio panel.
Dropbox status refresh every refreshIntervalSec (default 60 s, at least 10 s).
2 s start-up ramp that stops itself once dropboxd answers or after about 30 s.
20 s repaint of the time-zone globe's day/night line; no process.
5 min time-zone probe for the globe.
Tailscale status refresh every refreshIntervalSec.
2 s start-up ramp that stops itself once tailscaled answers or after about 30 s.
Weather refresh every refreshMinutes (default 15 min).
1 s tick of the clock the bar always shows; no process.
AI usage labels refresh: 5 s while the usage module is visible, 30 s otherwise, scaled by Ryoku.Perf.pollFactor.
System telemetry file reads (/proc stat, loadavg, meminfo): 2 s while a CPU or memory module is shown, 10 s otherwise, scaled by Ryoku.Perf.pollFactor; no process.
Imports Quickshell.Hyprland only for GlobalShortcut media keys, instantiated only when Wm.caps.globalShortcuts is true.
Weather refresh every 20 minutes.
1 s tick of the clock the bar always shows; no process.
Upstream Caelestia restarts `nmcli monitor` 2 s after it exits; it exits when NetworkManager restarts, and without NetworkManager it is retried every 2 s (item downloads are paused).
650 ms shape morph of a loading indicator while its `animated` property is true; no process.
Hourly weather refresh.
15 s uptime reload from /proc/uptime; no process.

Every hyprctl call that runs checks macWm.provider === "hyprland" (the Wm bridge serves other compositors); the coverProbe Process is never started, and the hyprpaper step of the wallpaper fallback chain fails over to the next tool.
Display-mode control runs only when modeControlSupported (provider hyprland); monProc/clientProc sit behind refreshBusy's Wm path, which always returns first.
geoProc is the hyprctl fallback poller, whose Timer is fixed at running: false because the Wm bridge supplies geometry.
30 s midnight rollover check of the calendar widget; no process.
Hourly time-zone offset refresh for the clock app.
Alarm and timer check: 1 s, 33 ms only while the stopwatch tab is shown; alarms must fire while the app is closed.
33 ms tick for the desktop clock widget's sweeping second hand; stops in previews, no process. Counted in the measured tier.
3 s gsettings color-scheme poll that follows the system light/dark mode; launches one process per tick. Counted in the measured tier.
6 s Wi-Fi and Bluetooth state refresh for the menu bar (nmcli, bounded bluetoothctl). Counted in the measured tier.
850 ms brightnessctl poll that shows the brightness OSD when hardware keys change it outside the shell. Counted in the measured tier.
1 s recording-time counter; runs only while a recording is in progress (recRun).
250 ms freshness flag for the glass backdrop snapshot, per bar window; no process.
Window-capture fallback for the Dock's live glass (33-200 ms); runs only while a capture source exists, live capture is unavailable and the dock can run.
Session-long dbus-monitor for KIconLoader iconChanged, started with pdeath so it dies with the shell; restarted 5 s after it exits, which happens only when the session bus goes away.
700 ms warning pulse; runs only while a resource reading is in its warning range.
1 s call duration; runs only during a phone call.
60 ms frame sampling; runs only while the phone mirror page is visible (pageLive) and not yet settled.
1 s alarm check; alarms must fire with every panel closed. No process.
Hourly re-arm of the wake schedule.
Device list resort: 2 s, 500 ms while a Bluetooth panel is open or discovering; runs only while the adapter is on. No process.
60 s calendar reminder check.
10 s uptime reload from /proc/uptime; no process.
1 s countdown; runs only while a timed idle inhibit is active.
10 s MPRIS player list refresh.
1 s /proc/net/dev read; runs only while monitoring is on or a widget holds the service (polling = monitoring || holderCount > 0).
CPU and memory file reads at effectiveResourceInterval, faster only while the resource popup monitors; no process.
Weather refresh every refreshInterval minutes.
1 s tick of the clock the bar always shows; no process.
10 s relative-time ticker of the notes widget face; no process.
Connects only when NIRI_SOCKET is set; under the item's Hyprland gate it stays idle.
